learning_outcomes.text: The theoretical and practical applications of this course provide an understanding of the concepts and principles.
Provides to develop the ability to establish a relationship between physics and the real world.
Provides preliminary skills to solve basic problems related to Mechanical Physics.
Describes the application of the basic laws of physics to special engineering systems.

syllabus_topics: Potential energy and conservation of energy
Midterm Exam, Linear momentum and collisions
Rotation of rigid bodies around a fixed axis
